title: Birds of the Reefs
text: “Since we’re heading to the beach, we’ll both need swimsuits.”
“A fundoshi!”
“A seashell!”
“Why those choices?”
It seems Keel and the Panda Beastman are both suggesting swimsuit options. Hmm? Keel’s choice looks familiar. I seem to recall him walking around the village wearing a fundoshi.
“As for Lars-chan… when she’s in her Demi-Human form, wouldn’t a skimpy bikini suit her better than a seashell?”
“You can crack open a shell and eat it, and it makes an excellent swimsuit!”
“I think something risqué would suit you. Something more alluring… Oh, Panda—I mean, when you’re a Beastman, why don’t you try wearing a leotard or something?”
“That’d look good on you.”
For some reason, the assistant, riding high on Rivalry, jumped at the chance.
“How about wearing something modeled after Filolial-sama’s head, with wings attached around the waist?”
“Huh!?”
My father burst out laughing. Isn’t this supposed to be a serious moment?
“It’d probably end up looking like a botched version of *Swan Lake*.”
“Are you trying to make a fool of me!?”
“Does Gaelion wear a swimsuit?”
“Hmm, does Gaelion-chan even need a swimsuit?”
“Really?”
The Rival asks my father. Come to think of it… I’m reminded of Filo-tan in a swimsuit. Just picturing that ethereal, divine sight of Filo-tan in a swimsuit really lifts my spirits.
“What about Sakura?”
“Sakura-chan needs one when she’s in human form, right? Otherwise, it’d be a crime.”
“Oh, I see. So what about Yuki and Kou, too?”
“It’d be a problem if they swam completely naked in human form. Melty-chan, if you see any swimsuits that look like they’d suit Sakura-chan, please pick one out for her.”
“Okay!”
“……Under no circumstances should Melty-chan wear a revealing swimsuit.”
As if I’d hit the nail on the head, my Finacée blushed and looked down. I have a feeling she’d be angry at this point in the future, but what on earth is going on?

With such thoughts running through my mind, we arrived at the port where the ship to Cal Mira Island was docked. Ren and Itsuki were already waiting in line to board the ship. It seemed boarding began almost as soon as we arrived. After that, we each went to the cabins we’d been assigned and relaxed until we set sail.
“It’s pretty windy, isn’t it?”
“That’s because of the waves. When I went to Cal Mira Island, there was a storm, too. I remember the ship rocking violently.”
“So, will this ship be the same?”
“Who knows? The date’s different from that time, after all.”

There’s a slight difference in the number of days. It’s been a while since we set sail, but Sakura-chan, Keel, and the other Filolial-samas are swimming and playing in the ocean in their Filolial Queen forms. Occasionally, monsters attack the Filolial-samas, but they easily fend them off. Father and I quickly dispatch the monsters.
“Motoyasu-sama!”
With a splash, Yuki-chan kicks a shark-like monster—a Blue Shark—toward me, so I swing my spear and fillet it into three pieces before it hits the deck.
“I’ll admit it’s impressive, but it really doesn’t make me hungry.”
“You guys sure know how to put on quite a show… I’m not really that good at naval combat, you know.”
There, a panda beastman is leaning her elbow on the ship’s railing and resting her chin in her hand.
“Come to think of it, Lars-chan used Magic to summon bamboo, didn’t she? Isn’t that a pretty rare kind of Magic?”
“In terms of elements, it’s earth-based. Around here, the most I can do is grow some bamboo on the ship.”
“It sounds like it might capsize the ship.”
“That’s the thing. Well, it’s good for wrecking ships, though. It also slows them down.”
“I’ve got a similar skill myself.”
“What kind?”
“It’s a skill that makes spears pop out of the ground. Think of it like the stakes used in castle battles to block enemy charges.”
It’s a skill for setting up obstacles. I hardly ever use it because it doesn’t have many practical uses.
“Huh… Since you don’t use it, does that mean Motoyasu-kun is so powerful himself that you’d rather be attacking than wasting time on it?”
“Exactly.”

In that sense, it’s a pretty useless skill. Well, it’d probably be effective if used on a defensive line against overwhelming enemy forces. It’ll slow them down. The downside is that if the enemy is flying, it’s completely useless.
Speaking of flying, there’s our Rival. He’s flying above the ship with his Assistant on board. Oh? They’ve landed over here.
“The wind smells fishy.”
“There’s a reef nearby, and there was something that looked like a Filolial.”
“Huh… A wild Filolial, maybe?”
“Seriously, they’re everywhere. They’re such a nuisance.”
“I can’t let that go unchallenged. Filolial-sama are wonderful creatures that can live anywhere, you know.”
“But they can’t fly.”
“Get out on deck! That’s the order.”
That’s the sort of conversation they were having. Ah, Ren and Itsuki did pop their heads out a little while ago. They were completely seasick and went back to their cabin pretty quickly.

I’ve gotten seasick in the past too, but I’m fine now. If you ride in a carriage driven by Filolial-sama, you can mysteriously overcome motion sickness. This, too, is one of Filolial-sama’s miracles. The ship continued on its way like that… but then, it was the middle of the night.
“Motoyasu-kun!”
My Father banged on the door of my cabin where I was sleeping. And to think I was enjoying a blissful sleep, breathing in the scent of Filolial-sama’s egg…
“What’s the matter? Has your Finacée turned into a nymphomaniac again?”
“No, that’s not it. Something’s wrong with the ship! Everyone—including the crew—is fast asleep and not moving.”
“What?”
Following Father’s lead, I searched the ship. Sure enough… the crew members were lying on their backs in the hallway, fast asleep.
“What on earth is going on?”
The panda beastman, puzzled by the unusual situation, is tapping a crew member on the cheek.
“…They just won’t wake up at all. Is this some kind of advanced sleep Magic or something?”
“I wonder what on earth is going on?”
My fiancée, also taken aback by the situation, snuggles up to Sakura-chan and asks her. This is strange. We were on a ship in the first world too, but nothing like this ever happened there.
“For now, I’m going to check out the captain’s cabin.”
“Could you do that for me?”
“Sure. Let’s go, Sakura-chan.”
“Okay. Then, Mel-chan, please follow right behind Sakura.”
Yuki-chan and Kou are also on high alert due to this unusual situation. Ah, I hear that Keel and Luna-chan were sound asleep, but they woke up when my Father shook them.
“What’s going on?”
After that, my Father and I went to the cabins where Ren and Itsuki were sleeping. When we banged on the cabin door, we heard a groaning voice.
“Ugh… W-what is it… ugh!”
Itsuki managed to crawl over and open the cabin door. He’s already out of commission, isn’t he?
“Ugh…”
It’d be a disaster if I tried to explain the situation clumsily and he ended up falling off the ship and dying. Let’s just have him stay in his cabin and sleep.
“Itsuki, I’m going to put you out of your misery right now! Sleep Lance!”
“Ugh—”
I delivered the finishing blow to Itsuki, who was suffering from seasickness, and tied him to the bed in the cabin. He’s sleeping with an expression of sheer agony on his face.
“Father, Itsuki’s so seasick he’s practically useless.”
“I’m feeling pretty much the same way. Ren, in particular, refuses to even leave his room—he says there’s no way he’s going out.”
So maybe we should put off reporting the situation for now?
“Come to think of it, Ren can’t swim at all.”
“Huh… really!?”
“That’s right.”
“He’s always trying to act so cool, but he can’t swim… It’s funny, but given the situation, it’s no laughing matter. We’re on a ship here, after all.”
“True. So, what about Ren, Itsuki, and the rest of the crew?”
When I went back to Itsuki’s cabin to check again, everyone was in a similar state. They’re no help at all. Even if they aren’t asleep, aren’t they all just out of commission?
“For now, let’s check what’s going on outside.”
“Got it.”
When we stepped out onto the deck, thick fog had rolled in.
